$comment: Dex-written content for the TMP era (#641), merged over the mod's text by pipeline/dexpipe/content.py. "auto" fields are derived from the ship's own weapons, abilities and research.

description.summary: An automated work craft of the 2280s that repairs damaged ships and builds new stations and subsystems for the fleet.

The Enterprise after her refit: new warp engines, phaser banks and photon torpedoes in a rebuilt Constitution-class hull. Faster and better armed than the ship she was, she remains Starfleet's best-known name.

fed_TMP_enterprise.source: Memory Alpha, USS Enterprise (NCC-1701). Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 2.

description.summary:
The Excelsior-class Enterprise-B, a larger and more powerful successor to the Constitution class. As the fleet's flagship she builds and launches new ships from her own bays.
The third ship to carry the name, and the first to carry it without Kirk at her helm. Her name alone carries the weight of the two ships before her, and Starfleet sends her where it most needs to be seen.

fed_TMP_flagship.source: Memory Alpha, USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-B). Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 40.

description.summary: A Regula-class outpost, Starfleet's standard frontier base of the 2280s. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
The orbital laboratory where the Genesis Device was developed. It plays no part in the fighting, but losing it would cost the Federation its most dangerous secret.

fed_TMP_regula.source: Memory Alpha, Regula I (Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan). Dimensions measured from the fed_TMP_regula model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary: A Miranda-class frigate seized by Khan Noonien Singh. Under his command she is a dangerous raider, with phasers and photon torpedoes and a captain who will stop at nothing.

fed_TMP_reliant.source: Memory Alpha, USS Reliant (NCC-1864). Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 11 (around 200).

description.summary: A Starfleet mining bee of the 2280s, sturdier than its forebears, that cuts dilithium from asteroids and carries it home for processing.
Starfleet's heavy yard of the 2280s, where cruisers and capital ships are built. It can dock one ship at a time for repairs.
A Starfleet shipyard of the 2280s for destroyers and light to medium cruisers, with one repair berth.
A huge orbital spacedock large enough to hold starships inside its doors. It builds and repairs ships, stores resources and protects the space around it with a warp inhibitor.

fed_TMP_starbase.source: Memory Alpha, Spacedock. Dimensions as the TNG Spacedock, whose model it shares in the Dex (it has none of its own).

description.summary:
The largest ship of the Gorn fleet, built in the Gorn way: slow, heavily armoured and covered in plasma weapons on wide-arc mounts. It out-lasts rather than out-flies its enemies, and builds new ships as it goes.
Named for the Gorn homeworld itself, she is the Hegemony made into a ship: patient, immovable and very hard to kill. Lesser vessels gather around her the way the Gorn gather around strength, and none of them will leave her side in battle.

grn_TMP_flagship.source: Starfleet Command II: Empires at War manual (Gorn tactics).

description.summary: A Leviathan-class outpost, as heavily built as anything the Gorn make. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets at arm's length.
A fixed Gorn plasma battery that shreds small ships. Best placed in groups to cover each other.
A Gorn engineering tender that projects energy onto allied ships to bolster their shields, and carries spares to repair them in the field.
A Gorn cargo vessel fitted with mining gear. Larger and tougher than other races' mining bees, it hauls dilithium back to the nearest freighter or outpost.
A Gorn sensor satellite that watches an area of space and relays what it sees, without risking a ship or crew.

grn_TMP_sensorsatellite.subtitle: Remote Sensor Satellite
grn_TMP_sensorsatellite.source: Dimensions measured from the grn_TMP_sensorsatellite model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary: A Gorn heavy shipyard that builds the Hegemony's cruisers and capital ships and repairs one ship at a time.
A Gorn shipyard that builds the Hegemony's destroyers and lighter cruisers and repairs one ship at a time.
A fixed Gorn torpedo launcher, slow to fire but punishing to large ships. Best placed in groups.
A work craft that keeps the Empire's K't'inga fleets in the fight, repairing damage and raising new stations and subsystems.

The flagship of the Klingon fleet, a cloaking command ship armed with disruptor beams, pulses and torpedoes. It builds and launches new warships from its own bays.
She flies at the head of the Empire's fleets in an age of uneasy peace, ready for the war many Klingons still want. Her commander speaks for the High Council in the field, and her decks have seen more challenges for command than any other ship in the fleet.
A Kan'Qul-class outpost, enlarged for the fleets of the 2280s. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
An Imperial mining bee that keeps dilithium flowing to the Empire's K't'inga fleets.
An old warship hull pulled out of retirement for mining duty. It processes dilithium right on the battlefield and keeps its own flight of mining bees.
An Imperial shipyard for destroyers and lighter cruisers, able to dock one ship for repairs.
A work craft that repairs the Star Empire's ships and builds new stations and subsystems wherever they are needed.

The flagship of the Romulan fleet, a cloaking warbird with plasma torpedoes and disruptors. It builds and launches new ships from its own bays.
The pride of a Star Empire that shows its strength only when it must. Her commander answers to the Praetor, and her arrival is how the Empire tells an enemy that the talking is over.

A Ralkat'han-class outpost, larger than the Jaltak bases before it. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps intruders from jumping in unannounced.
A Romulan mining bee that gathers dilithium for the Star Empire's growing fleet of warbirds.
A larger Romulan mining freighter of the 2280s that processes dilithium in the field and supports a flight of mining bees.
A small, fast scout that can cloak and sweep the area with a sensor ping, finding the enemy long before it is found.
